mapper.select: select * from account where login_id=#{value} and status = 'ACTIVE'

select a.*, e.name as user_name, r.role_name, b.name as branch_name from account a left join employee e on a.emp_no = e.emp_no left join branch b on a.branch_code = b.branch_code left join role r on a.role_id = r.role_id where a.login_id=#{value} and a.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update account set last_login_at = now() where account_id = #{value}
mapper.select: select count(account_id) as totalAccount from account
select count(account_id) as activeAccount from account where status = 'ACTIVE'
select count(account_id) as inactiveAccount from account where status = 'INACTIVE'

select a.*, e.name as user_name, r.role_name, b.name as branch_name from account a left join employee e on a.emp_no = e.emp_no left join branch b on a.branch_code = b.branch_code left join role r on a.role_id = r.role_id
AND b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{branchName}, '%')
AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND a.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{loginId}, '%')
ORDER BY a.account_id DESC
SELECT emp_no AS empNo FROM employee WHERE emp_no = #{value}
SELECT emp_no AS empNo FROM account WHERE emp_no = #{value}
mapper.update: update account set status = CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'INACTIVE' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END where account_id = #{value}
UPDATE account SET role_id = #{roleId}, branch_code = #{branchCode}, status = #{status} WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
